name: Select
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Select(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

SelectContent.description: The Select's popup: a listbox of SelectItems (and SelectGroups / SelectSeparators). Opened by the controller in the top layer, over the trigger or `side: :top` / `:bottom` of it.

SelectGroup.description: A labelled section of a Select's list: SelectGroupLabel plus its SelectItems.

SelectGroupLabel.description: The visible label of a SelectGroup.

SelectItem.description: One option of a Select. `value:` is what it submits; `label:` is what the trigger shows and typeahead matches (the item's text by default). Mark a leading element `data: { icon: "start" }`.

SelectTrigger.description: The button that opens the Select, styled like Input. `clearable: true` adds a ✕ (Delete / Backspace clear too); `start_slot:` / `end_slot:` take an icon name, text or a block - `start_slot: :selected` mirrors the selected item's `data: { icon: "start" }` element (a flag, an avatar). Put SelectValue inside.

SelectValue.description: The selection shown in the trigger: the item's label (from the root's `items:`, or read from the list), `placeholder:` when empty. With `multiple`, one label or `summary:` ("%{count} selected", translated by default) for several.

examples.name: Usage
Variants
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col gap-4") do
    %i[ outline soft ].each do |variant|
      Select(variant:) do
        SelectTrigger(aria_label: "Pick a fruit (#{variant})") { SelectValue(placeholder: "Pick a fruit") }
        SelectContent { instance_exec(&FRUIT_ITEMS) }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.notes: `size:` scales the trigger, popup radius and items together.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col gap-4") do
    %i[ sm md lg ].each do |size|
      Select(size:) do
        SelectTrigger(aria_label: "Pick a fruit (#{size})") { SelectValue(placeholder: "Pick a fruit") }
        SelectContent { instance_exec(&FRUIT_ITEMS) }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Grouped options
Clearable
examples.notes: `clearable: true` on the trigger adds a ✕ once there's a value (Delete / Backspace clear too).

examples.name: Disabled & error states
Start & end slots
examples.notes: With a start slot, open below the trigger (`align_item_with_trigger: false`).
examples.code:
phlex do
  Select(default_value: "Credit card", align_item_with_trigger: false, class: "w-full max-w-70") do
    SelectTrigger(aria_label: "Payment method", start_slot: :credit_card, end_slot: -> { span(class: "text-foreground-subtle text-xs") { "Default" } }) do
      SelectValue(placeholder: "Payment method")
    end
    SelectContent { [ "Credit card", "PayPal", "Bank transfer", "Apple Pay", "Google Pay" ].each { |method| SelectItem(value: method) { method } } }
  end
end

examples.name: Country select
examples.notes: `start_slot: :selected` mirrors the selected item's flag into the trigger.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Select(default_value: "us", align_item_with_trigger: false, name: "country", class: "w-full max-w-70") do
    SelectTrigger(aria_label: "Select a country", start_slot: :selected) { SelectValue(placeholder: "Select a country") }
    SelectContent do
      %w[ au br ca fr de jp gb us ].each do |code|
        SelectItem(value: code) do
          CountryFlag(code, class: "size-4.5 text-base", data: { icon: "start" })
          plain I18n.t("ui_components.countries.#{code}", default: code.upcase)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Showing a label for the value
examples.notes: When values differ from labels, `items:` lets the closed trigger show "Pro" instead of "pro".

examples.name: Multiple selection
examples.notes: Selected items keep a check; `SelectValue(summary:)` words the count.

examples.name: In a form
examples.notes: Inside a Field it's labelled and validated like any control: submit without a choice.
examples.code:
phlex do
  form(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col items-start gap-4", data: { demo: "form" }) do
    Field(name: "fruit", messages: { value_missing: "Pick a fruit to continue." }, class: "w-full") do
      FieldLabel { "Favorite fruit" }
      Select(required: true) do
        SelectTrigger { SelectValue(placeholder: "Pick a fruit") }
        SelectContent { instance_exec(&FRUIT_ITEMS) }
      end
      FieldError()
    end
    Button(type: "submit", size: :sm) { "Continue" }
  end
  script(type: "module") do
    raw safe(%(document.querySelector("[data-demo=form]").addEventListener("submit", event => event.preventDefault())))
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(dir: "rtl", class: "w-full max-w-70") do
    Select(default_value: "تفاح") do
      SelectTrigger(aria_label: "اختر فاكهة") { SelectValue(placeholder: "اختر فاكهة") }
      SelectContent { %w[ تفاح موز برتقال فراولة ].each { |fruit| SelectItem(value: fruit) { fruit } } }
    end
  end
end

example_helpers.FRUIT_ITEMS: FRUIT_ITEMS = proc { FRUITS.each { |fruit| SelectItem(value: fruit) { fruit } } }
example_helpers.FRUITS: FRUITS = %w[ Apple Banana Blueberry Grapes Orange Strawberry ].freeze
